changes: The library search is now simply SEARCH, and Add ROM is a cleaner one-line action in both library views.
Library, tabletop, and empty-state buttons now have a quicker lift-and-shadow hover response.
The contrast slider and the LCD correction panel now use the same comfortable vertical spacing.
The accuracy snapshot now uses one pinned ROM set and separates strict passes from diagnostic reference results.
Core-only testing shows LAB ahead of SameBoy by 86.9% on the DMG workload and 48.4% on the CGB workload on the release laptop.
The README has been rebuilt around the single-file experience, saves, screenshots, accuracy, and practical performance outcomes.
